kehillah_missing_parshanut_work_trigger = {
	$LIBRARY$ = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				current_date >= 300.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 250.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } }
			}

			}

			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim } }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim } }
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_rashi_torah } }

kehillah_owns_any_torah_work_trigger = {
	OR = {
		kehillah_owns_parshanut_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
		kehillah_owns_talmudics_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
		kehillah_owns_hashkafa_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
	}
}

# Scope: the studying character. Does $LIBRARY$ still hold the work named by
# kehillah_study_current_work_id (the scheme's numeric bridge, 1..N in catalog order)?
kehillah_study_torah_current_work_still_owned_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 1
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 2
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 3
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 4
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 5
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishnah } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 6
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_zeraim } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 7
			$LIBRARY$ = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_moed } }
		}

# Scope: a character with var:kehillah_own_library. The ransom pool holds a
# work his library lacks.
kehillah_lib_can_redeem_trigger = {
	var:kehillah_own_library ?= {

				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_sefer_haqabbalah }

			}
			AND = {

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_ibn_tibbon_moreh } }

			AND = {

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_hamanhig } }

			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_radak_shorashim }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_radak_shorashim } }

			AND = {

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_responsa_maharam } }

			AND = {

			AND = {

		}
	}
